title: Jikkyou Powerful Pro Yakyuu S
native_title: 実況パワフルプロ野球Ｓ
overview:
Latest Edition: The Strongest "Pawapuro" Is Here.

The famous "Pawapuro" arrives on the Sega Saturn, bringing Success Mode with it. The pro baseball game of the future is powerful!

This officially licensed Japanese pro baseball game features all twelve Central and Pacific League teams, with player data based on the rosters at the start of the 1997 season. Live play-by-play commentary is provided by ABC sports announcer Noriyuki Abe.

In Success Mode you raise your own pitcher or fielder, choosing details such as a pitching form. Play alone against the computer or with a friend.

- Licensed teams and players, with stadiums including the Osaka Dome and Nagoya Dome
- Success Mode for developing original pitchers and fielders
- 1 or 2 players

最新版 最強の「パワプロ」、来た。

あの「パワプロ」がサクセスモードをひっさげて、セガサターンに登場。これからのプロ野球ゲームは、パワフルだ!
